name: iron-wasteland
description: Phaser 3 browser game, plain script files in src/. Edit and refresh, no build step.

scripts.check: for f in game.js src/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in src/*.js; do grep -q "src=\"$f\"" index.html || { echo "check: $f has no <script> tag in index.html"; exit 1; }; done && node scripts/check-manifest.js && node scripts/check-scoreboard.js && npm run -s lint
scripts.smoke: npm install --no-save playwright@1.63.0 && npx playwright install --with-deps webkit && node scripts/smoke.js
